chunk.text:
IBM UDX compilation error - United States

TECHNOTE (TROUBLESHOOTING)

THIS DOCUMENT APPLIES ONLY TO THE FOLLOWING LANGUAGE VERSION(S):
 English 

PROBLEM(ABSTRACT)
 Following error can be met during UDX compilation.
Can't exec "/nz/kit/bin/adm/nzudxcompile": Argument list too long 

SYMPTOM
nzudxcompile command returns an "Argument list too long" error and aborts.


CAUSE
ARG_MAX configuration parameter limits the number of argument list in command line. In this case the client used more than 131072 argument with many program *.c files.

DIAGNOSING THE PROBLEM
Check ARG_MAX value in the command line: 

$ getconf ARG_MAX
131072


RESOLVING THE PROBLEM
This ARG_MAX kernel parameter adjusted to much larger from kernel release version 2.6.23, that is 2621440 (http://www.in-ulm.de/~mascheck/various/argmax [http://www.in-ulm.de/~mascheck/various/argmax]). 

But we support upto Redhat 5.11 in Twinfin which is less than kernel release 2.6.23. So we have no way to allow ARG_MAX larger than 131072 at this time.

IBM NDN ERROR: Unable to calculate cksum - United States

TECHNOTE (TROUBLESHOOTING)

PROBLEM(ABSTRACT)
 NDN ERROR: Unable to calculate cksum 

RESOLVING THE PROBLEM
The problem that causes this error is that the nz user needs to have read and execute privileges to the .o_x86 file and all of the directories leading to that file. 

1. Check the privileges for the /mnt/home/udx directory and all of the directories above it.
2. You will need to give the nz user account permissions (either through ACL or by giving world read/execute privileges) to those directories. 

If changing permissions on the directories is not possible, do the following:
1. Change to the /tmp directory
2. Compile the source into object files; no registration
3. Change permissions for all directories starting from /tmp and the object files to execute
4. Use the create or replace command to register the function

IBM Unable to open udx source file for reading - United States

TECHNOTE (TROUBLESHOOTING)

PROBLEM(ABSTRACT)
 You extracted User Define Function (UDF) definitions from source server and trying to recreate the same on a target server. However, create function operation is failing with error. For example:

***** Creating function: "ADD_ELEMENT"
nzsql:My_function.sql:10: ERROR: Unable to open udx source file for reading 
/tmp/nz_udx_object_files/9999219.oh 

CAUSE

The object file(s) associated with the UDF are inaccessible. Check the directory and files mentioned in the error message are exist and have appropriate read/write permissions.

If you are using the 'nz_ddl_function' script for extract UDF definitions, copy all the object files under /tmp/nz_udx_object_files directory from source server to target server. Make sure directory and file permissions are same on both source and target servers. Then try to create the same function on the target server.

Important : Above are some possible cause of the problem. If this document does not give you what you need then search for other documents with the same problem.

IBM UDX compilation error - United States

TECHNOTE (TROUBLESHOOTING)

THIS DOCUMENT APPLIES ONLY TO THE FOLLOWING LANGUAGE VERSION(S):

PROBLEM(ABSTRACT)
 Following error can be met during UDX compilation.
Can't exec "/nz/kit/bin/adm/nzudxcompile": Argument list too long 

SYMPTOM
nzudxcompile command returns an "Argument list too long" error and aborts.


CAUSE
ARG_MAX configuration parameter limits the number of argument list in command line. In this case the client used more than 131072 argument with many program *.c files.

DIAGNOSING THE PROBLEM
Check ARG_MAX value in the command line: 

$ getconf ARG_MAX
131072


RESOLVING THE PROBLEM
This ARG_MAX kernel parameter adjusted to much larger from kernel release version 2.6.23, that is 2621440 (http://www.in-ulm.de/~mascheck/various/argmax [http://www.in-ulm.de/~mascheck/various/argmax]). 

But we support upto Redhat 5.11 in Twinfin which is less than kernel release 2.6.23. So we have no way to allow ARG_MAX larger than 131072 at this time.
